messages:
maria: Hey team — kicking off Blazar alpha lab readiness checklist under NDA. Need green on: lab access creds, telemetry endpoint, benchmark workloads, and announcement timing. Can folks confirm owners? :wave:

karen: I'll review NDA by EOD tomorrow. Any special clauses for telem data? cc @maria

maria: @karen thank you — prefer minimal preview clause + telemetry for perf only, pseudonymized. I'll DM the partner legal contact.

ashish: Hardware image built, needs firmware 2.1.3 applied. Can Ops schedule a handoff window? Also will surface perf regression test harness next message.

leo (Infra): Ops can do Tue/Wed next week AM PST. Need exact list of IP ranges and lab creds. 

nina: For benchmarks, suggested runs: 1) latency p95 single-stream, 2) throughput 16-stream, 3) kv-cache warm/cold. I can own run scripts and result uploads. Need partner-provided sample model snapshots (quantized & fp16).

sam: I'll prep a short partner playbook for Marketplace listing notes — no public announcement until partner gives go. Also will draft joint announcement timeline once NDA cleared.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-3221 for Blazar lab handoff (assignee: nina). ETA: 2024-06-12

ashish: Test harness outline:
```
run_latency.sh --model snapshot_v1 --seq 128 --batch 1 --measure p95
run_throughput.sh --model snapshot_v1 --seq 512 --batch 16 --duration 300
```
I'll post container image link in thread when ready.

maria: Action list summary: @karen NDA review (EOD tmw); @ashish firmware + harness; @leo schedule Tue/Wed; @nina run benchmarks + upload; @sam marketplace prep; I'll coordinate partner comms. Please react with :thumbsup: when done.

karen: :thumbsup: will send redlines.

leo (Infra): :thumbsup: added IP whitelist template to the ticket.

nina: Quick q — do we use prefix caching enabled for throughput runs? If yes, state cache warming steps.

ashish: Yes, enable prefix/KV caching for throughput. Warming step: run warmup.sh 1000 tokens before measurement.

sam: Noting no public assets until partner OK. We'll keep a private announcement draft in docs/partners.

maria: Great — looping in partner contact + setting weekly sync Friday 9am PT. Thanks everyone.
